key_errors: E: Failed to fetch http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/j/javascript-common/javascript-common_11%2bnmu1_all.deb  Could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80 (52.161.185.214), connection timed out

root_cause: The Debian Packages job failed because the GitHub Actions runner could not reach azure.archive.ubuntu.com during apt-get package installation. Multiple package downloads timed out or returned connection-refused errors. This is a transient network infrastructure issue affecting the Azure-hosted Ubuntu package mirror, unrelated to any code changes in the PR.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed Debian Packages job - the network issue is transient and a retry is likely to succeed.
If recurring, consider adding retry logic to apt-get commands in the Debian packages job workflow.
Monitor azure.archive.ubuntu.com availability - if persistent, report to GitHub Actions infrastructure team.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network failure, not reproducible locally.
prevention_strategies: Add retry logic to apt-get commands in the Debian packages CI job.
Consider using a local/cached mirror for critical packages.
